about: Maps every website section and FAQ entry to the app feature it describes, with the app source of truth. Maintained by the sync-with-app skill: Step 2 diffs the app's current feature list against this file; Step 4 updates it for every feature touched. App paths are relative to the app repo (APP_REPO_PATH), read-only. Never copy code from those files; they are pointers to check claims against.

seeded_against.method: Each app source file was checked to exist on the app's work-branch (git cat-file, read-only). Claims were mapped, not re-verified one by one; the first skill run verifies them.

status_values.merged: Code is on the app's work-branch. May be described as available in the app.
status_values.parked: Not built or deliberately parked. May only appear as 'coming later', and only with human approval.
status_values.beta: App-wide launch status (private beta, still cooking).
status_values.site-only: Describes the website itself, or is editorial with no app feature behind it.

features.app_feature: App identity, platforms and launch status (private beta, Android and iOS, no download yet)

features.notes: The site says both platforms are in private beta and 'still cooking'. The iOS wording is a human decision (decisions.md); do not change it from the app's state alone.
